articulate one's views: In the debate, each student had two minutes to articulate their views clearly and politely.
在辯論中，每位學生有兩分鐘清楚且有禮貌地表達自己的看法。
articulate a vision: A good leader must articulate a vision that inspires people to work toward the same goal.
一位好的領導者必須闡述一個能激勵人們朝同一目標努力的願景。
articulate the problem: Before we look for solutions, let's try to articulate the problem in one clear sentence.
在我們尋找解決辦法之前，先試著用一個清楚的句子說清楚問題。
assemble a team: The coach needs to assemble a team of strong swimmers before the national competition in May.
教練需要在五月的全國比賽前組成一支由強壯泳者組成的團隊。
assemble evidence: The police spent months assembling evidence before they finally arrested the suspect.
警方花了好幾個月蒐集證據，最後才逮捕了嫌犯。
assemble furniture: My dad spent a whole afternoon trying to assemble furniture for my room without reading the instructions.
我爸爸花了一整個下午，沒看說明書就試著幫我的房間組裝家具。
the crowd assembled: The crowd assembled in front of the stadium hours before the concert, hoping to see the singer arrive.
演唱會開始前幾個小時，群眾就聚集在體育館前，希望看到歌手抵達。
assert one's rights: The workers learned how to assert their rights when the company refused to pay them for extra hours.
當公司拒絕支付加班費時，工人們學會了如何主張自己的權利。
assert authority: On the first day of class, the new teacher tried to assert authority by setting strict rules.
開學第一天，新老師試著藉由訂定嚴格的規定來展現權威。
assert oneself: Shy students often find it hard to assert themselves in group discussions, even when they have good ideas.
害羞的學生在小組討論中常常很難表現自我、據理力爭，即使他們有好點子。
assert that: In court, the man firmly asserted that he had been at home all night, but nobody believed him.
在法庭上，那名男子堅定地斷言他整晚都待在家裡，但沒有人相信他。
assess the damage: After the typhoon, experts visited the village to assess the damage and decide how much money repairs would cost.
颱風過後，專家們到村莊評估損害，並判斷修復需要花多少錢。
assess risk: Banks assess risk carefully before lending money to small businesses, checking their income and debts.
銀行在借錢給小型企業之前會仔細評估風險，檢查他們的收入和債務。
assess students' progress: Teachers use short weekly quizzes to assess students' progress and find out who needs extra help.
老師們用每週的小考來評量學生的進步，並找出誰需要額外的幫助。
assign homework: Our English teacher likes to assign homework every Friday, so we always have something to do on weekends.
我們的英文老師喜歡每週五指派作業，所以我們週末總是有事情做。
assign blame: After the project failed, the manager refused to assign blame and asked everyone to learn from the mistakes.
專案失敗後，經理拒絕歸咎責任，並要求大家從錯誤中學習。
assign a value: In this math game, you assign a value to each letter and then add them up to find the answer.
在這個數學遊戲中，你要賦予每個字母一個數值，然後把它們加起來找出答案。
assign someone to a task: The leader assigned each member to a task, so everyone knew exactly what to do during the event.
隊長指派每位成員一項任務，所以活動期間每個人都清楚知道要做什麼。
assist in the investigation: Several witnesses came forward to assist in the investigation after the car accident on the highway.
高速公路車禍發生後，有幾位目擊者挺身而出協助調查。
assist the elderly: Volunteers at the station assist the elderly with their bags and help them find the right train.
車站的志工協助老人提行李，並幫他們找到正確的火車。
assist with the move: My cousins came over on Saturday to assist with the move to our new apartment downtown.
我的表兄弟姊妹星期六過來幫忙搬家，搬到我們在市中心的新公寓。
associate A with B: Many people associate the smell of rain with peaceful childhood days in the countryside.
許多人把雨的味道與在鄉下度過的平靜童年時光聯想在一起。
be associated with risk: Extreme sports like skydiving are associated with risk, so players must receive careful training first.
像跳傘這樣的極限運動與風險有關，所以參與者必須先接受仔細的訓練。
associate with bad company: His parents worried that he would get into trouble if he continued to associate with bad company after school.
他的父母擔心，如果他放學後繼續結交壞朋友，會惹上麻煩。
assume responsibility: When the old manager retires next month, Ms. Chen will assume responsibility for the whole department by herself.
下個月老經理退休後，陳小姐將獨自承擔整個部門的責任。
assume office: The new president will assume office in May and has promised to improve the economy quickly.
新總統將於五月就職，並承諾會迅速改善經濟。
assume control: After the owner retired, his daughter assumed control of the family restaurant and made several changes.
老闆退休後，他的女兒接管了家族餐廳，並做了幾項改變。
assume a false name: The thief assumed a false name to rent the apartment, so the police could not find him easily.
小偷使用假名租下公寓，所以警方無法輕易找到他。
assume that: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules just because they have played the game before.
不要只因為大家以前玩過這個遊戲，就假設每個人都知道規則。
